enchantment.carianstyle.time_reversal.de: Upon lethal damage, prevents death and grants 5s of invulnerability. Damage taken during that time is stored and reflected back at attackers; when it ends, restore HP equal to 25% of the stored damage (300s cooldown).

enchantment.carianstyle.golden_law.desc: Damage dealt +15%, scaling with lost HP up to +60%. Gain 15% damage negation. Immune to any single hit dealing 15% or less of your max HP, at most once every 5s.
enchantment.carianstyle.offer_sword.desc: At full HP, attacks deal an additional [Level] x 10% damage.

enchantment.carianstyle.scarlet_rot.desc: Attacks inflict Scarlet Rot 1 for [Level] x 20s: 3% of current HP plus 0.075% of max HP as magic damage per second (ignores armor, +33% per level), healing received -25%, armor -50%.

enchantment.carianstyle.exclude.desc: On being attacked, knock back every creature within ([Level] - 1) x 0.75 + 1.5 blocks with a force of [Level] x 0.2.
enchantment.carianstyle.topps_stand.desc: No creature within 6 blocks, including yourself, can deal or take magic damage.
enchantment.carianstyle.causality_princi: After taking damage from creatures 5 times, deal retaliatory damage equal to [Level] x 75% of that damage to every creature within [Level] x 3 blocks.
enchantment.carianstyle.beast_vitality.d: All buff and debuff durations +[Level] x 30%.
enchantment.carianstyle.freezing_earthqu: Triggers once you have accumulated damage equal to 25% of your max HP: launch every creature within ([Level] - 1) x 3 + 5 blocks with a force of [Level] x 0.35 and inflict Frostbite [Level] for [Level] x 5s: movement speed -[Level] x 7.5%, and [Level] x 0.25% of max HP as physical damage every 0.5s (+100% per level).

enchantment.carianstyle.calamity.desc: §cCurse§r Damage taken x1.5. Hostile creatures strongly prefer to target you.

enchantment.carianstyle.empty_epilepsy_f: Arrow hits burn you for 10% of your max HP over 3s, and burn the target for [Level] x 0.2 times that self-inflicted damage. While burning, healing received -90%.
enchantment.carianstyle.call_star.desc: Where the arrow lands, creatures within [Level] x 2 blocks are pulled to the center, then lightning falls on every creature within [Level] blocks, dealing [Level] x 30% of the arrow's damage (x3 at night).

enchantment.carianstyle.dark_moon.desc: At night: magic damage +25%, magic damage negation +25%, healing received +25%, and gain Night Vision. enchantment.carianstyle.stars_law.desc: At night: healing received +50%, movement speed +25%. Dealing damage or taking physical damage inflicts Frostbite 1 on the target for 10s (+1 level if already applied, up to 10). Magic damage against frostbitten targets +[Frostbite Level] x 7.5%.

config.carianstyle.title: Carian Style Configuration
config.carianstyle.enableDetailedLogging:
Logs every detail to the console,
including enchantment triggers, attribute calculations and event handling.
§c⚠ Warning: this produces a huge amount of log output!§r
§cEnable only while debugging!§r
List the IDs of the enchantments you want to keep from registering.
You can find each enchantment's ID in the language file.
§7Example:§r ["scarlet_rot", "doomed_death"]
Disabled enchantments will:
• Not be registered in-game
• Not be obtainable from an enchanting table
• Not be obtainable via commands
config.carianstyle.rockBlasterMaxRange.t:
Maximum mining radius of the Bedrock Blast enchantment.
§710§r = a radius of 10 blocks (default)
This decides how many blocks can be mined in each direction at once.
Higher values mine faster but may cause lag.
§cValues above 15 are not recommended.§r
config.carianstyle.prayerfulStrikeMaxHea:
Caps the max HP that Prayerful Strike can accumulate.
§71000§r = up to 1000 HP (default)
This limits the bonus HP gained from kills
and prevents HP from stacking indefinitely.
config.carianstyle.isTreasureVeryRareEnc:
Turns every Very Rare enchantment into a treasure enchantment.
§7false§r = normal enchantments (default)
§7true§r = treasure enchantments
Treasure enchantments cannot be obtained from an enchanting table,
only from loot.
config.carianstyle.isTreasureRareEnchant:
Turns every Rare enchantment into a treasure enchantment.
§7false§r = normal enchantments (default)
§7true§r = treasure enchantments
config.carianstyle.isTreasureUncommonEnc:
Turns every Uncommon enchantment into a treasure enchantment.
§7false§r = normal enchantments (default)
§7true§r = treasure enchantments
config.carianstyle.levelLimit.tooltip:
Caps the effect of certain enchantments beyond their intended level
to keep them from becoming unbeatable.
§7false§r = no cap (default)
§7true§r = enforce the cap
When enabled, effects stop scaling past the cap even at higher levels.
Multiplier applied to enchanting cost.
§71.0§r = default difficulty
Higher values raise the enchantability cost,
making these enchantments harder to obtain.
§7Examples:§r
• 2.0 = twice as hard
• 0.5 = half as hard
config.carianstyle.useVanillaRarityWeigh:
Makes the enchanting table draw this mod's enchantments weighted by rarity.
§7true§r = use the mapping (default)
§7false§r = every enchantment uses the highest weight

§eVanilla weights:§r
• COMMON = 10
• UNCOMMON = 5
• RARE = 2
• VERY_RARE = 1
When disabled, every Carian Style enchantment is drawn at weight 10 -
the same tier as Efficiency, Protection and Sharpness, which pushes
vanilla enchantments out of the candidate pool.

§cSide effect:§r
Anvil costs also read rarity (a 1/2/4/8 multiplier),
so enabling this makes Rare and Very Rare enchantments
more expensive at the anvil.
config.carianstyle.allowVillagerBookTrad: Allow Villager Trades for This Mod's Books

Whether Carian Style enchantments may appear in librarian book trades.
§7false§r = blocked (default)
§7true§r = allowed (matches vanilla behaviour)

§cNote:§r
Vanilla picks §euniformly at random§r from every tradeable enchantment,
ignoring rarity weights entirely. Enabling this drops over a hundred
entries into a pool of roughly 40 vanilla ones, cutting the odds of
seeing Mending to about a quarter of what they were.

§7This option does not affect enchanting tables or loot chests.§r
config.carianstyle.enableTrueDamage.tool:
Uses in-depth field detection to bypass armor and protection,
so true damage works on every creature, modded ones included.
§7true§r = advanced detection (recommended, default)
§7false§r = simple setHealth approach

§cNote:§r when disabled, some modded creatures may not take true damage,
though performance improves slightly.
config.carianstyle.rockBlasterSuppressCo: Bedrock Blast: Suppress Common Stone Drops

When enabled, Bedrock Blast produces no drops for common stone blocks.
Affected blocks: stone, cobblestone, deepslate, cobbled deepslate, granite,
diorite, andesite, tuff, calcite, smooth basalt,
gravel, netherrack, basalt, blackstone and end stone.
Effectively prevents the lag caused by huge numbers of dropped items.
§7false§r = normal drops (default)
§7true§r = common stone does not drop
config.carianstyle.allowMobTriggerEnchan:
Whether non-player creatures may trigger Carian Style enchantments.
§7true§r = allowed (default, matches vanilla behaviour)
§7false§r = blocked (enchantments on mobs do not trigger)

§ePerformance tip:§r
On servers with many enchanted mobs, disabling this cuts overhead noticeably,
because it skips scanning mob equipment slots and parsing their NBT.

§cNote:§r
This only blocks triggers that go through the central event handler.
A few enchantments use their own @SubscribeEvent listeners
and are not affected by this switch.
config.carianstyle.allowMobTriggerDeathE: Allow Mobs to Trigger Death Enchantments

Whether non-player creatures may trigger death and near-death enchantments.
§7false§r = blocked (recommended default)
§7true§r = allowed

§eCoverage:§r
• DEAD category: Scarlet Aeonia, Spreading Frenzy, Greatblade Phalanx,
  Ancient Dragons' Lightning Strike
• Near-death triggers in the RECOLLECT category: Full Moon,
  Those Who Live in Death, Placidusax's Rewind

§cKeeping this disabled is recommended.§r
It stops elite mobs and bosses from gaining revives, area retaliation,
lightning storms and homing glintblades the instant they are killed,
which players tend to find deeply unfair.

§7Note:§r this option only applies when "Allow Mobs to Trigger Enchantments" above is enabled.
config.carianstyle.hideStealthHitbox.too:
Players under Carian Style stealth show no hitbox in anyone's F3+B view.
§7true§r = hidden (default)
§7false§r = shown (old behaviour)

§eWhy:§r
Stealth only hides the player model; vanilla F3+B still draws the hitbox,
so anyone can see through stealth in PvP just by pressing F3+B.

§7Server-authoritative:§r in multiplayer the server's setting applies;
this option on a client has no effect there.
